source_note: Fixed Renderer protocol. The selected external HostProfile supplies host thinking, expression, and positional examples for this run; this file owns only dynamic blocks, paragraph authority, and example-safety rules.

dynamic_blocks.chunk_position_block: The program derives chunk_index, chunk_count, and segment_position from the complete ordered RenderContract sequence, then injects the paragraph-authority description for that position.
dynamic_blocks.host_thinking_block: Generated from the selected HostProfile.host_thinking; controls only observation, judgment, and organization.
dynamic_blocks.host_expression_block: Generated from the selected HostProfile.host_expression; controls only expression.
dynamic_blocks.style_examples_block: Uses segment_position to inject external source-to-render conversion examples from the selected HostProfile; demonstrates only selection, organization, viewpoint placement, and spoken rhythm, and is not a factual source for the current project.
dynamic_blocks.fact_context_block: Planned deduplication hints for concurrent Renderers; identifies only repetition risk already scheduled in earlier plans, is not a factual source, and contains no body text from another chunk.
dynamic_blocks.annotated_materials_block: The current RenderContract's final visible evidence packet after Node Edit; unmarked text is factual material, while directives are inserted only as local controls.
dynamic_blocks.forbidden_block: Taken from the current RenderContract.forbidden_claims; `none` when empty.

segment_positions.opening: You have entry authority for the whole episode: establish the episode's question, angle of observation, or necessary premise and move naturally into the current material. Do not preview an outline or complete later conclusions early.
segment_positions.middle: You do not have authority to reopen or close the whole episode: continue the established narrative and advance the current material directly. Do not greet, restart the central question, or elevate a local result into the episode's final conclusion.
segment_positions.ending: First handle the current material completely, then use whole-episode closing authority: recover an established central question, judgment, or aftertaste without introducing a new question, new material, or a larger climax.
segment_positions.single: This segment has entry, progression, and closing authority together. Complete all three naturally around the same material without previewing an outline or expanding into channel ritual.

style_example_protocol.selection: For Host v2, select one sample from the current segment_position pool using a stable run/chunk key; for single, select one opening and one ending sample. Preserve the historical two-sample projection for Host v1.
usage: Examples are external preferred finished scripts unrelated to the current project. Their materials, facts, proper names, sentences, and metaphors must never enter the current body text.
Learn selection, connection, viewpoint placement, and spoken rhythm from material to prose; do not reproduce the example's subject, sentence shape, or paragraph length.
A sample pool may retain multiple organizational shapes. Selection is reproducible within one run and may vary across runs; never insert the entire pool into one prompt.
